population: All162069 qualified source Train Base26 windows, no residual eligibility restriction
state_rule: Unmodified collect_m3_formal_results.py::observed_states; exact AST function only, not importing parent module
fold_algorithm: One deterministic SHA order within fault-directory x historical-flight-directory association-group strata, round-robin from least-populated fold. No state/outcome-optimized retries. Frozen association_group unchanged.
support_threshold_provenance: Reuse prior conditioned-residual descriptive support thresholds as engineering gates only, not statistical power or application safety standards
no_normal_state_policy: Keep all IDs, mark unsupported. No reference fill or interpreting unavailable as normal. No generalization claim for unsupported state.
pre_post_pair: Same case latest whole-known pre_fault window and earliest whole-known stable_fault window; gaps retained. Observational, not causal or continuous-event latency.
distribution_unit: One case x state x known label median of per-window physical summaries. Fixed-direction signed AUC against independent normal cases only, no sign flipping, thresholds, or classifier fit.
normal_domain_comparison: Case and association-group descriptions, no IID-window p-values
historical_encoder_exposure: Full Train-supervised M0 features cannot support independent unseen-case validation. Future outer fold encoder and all fitted stats must exclude outer-held-out groups.
